name: Preferred Artwork
description:
Preferred Artwork proxies one or more existing Jellyfin remote image providers,
merges their remote image results, then filters and sorts artwork by language,
fallback language, width, height, provider score, and resolution.
overview: Proxy existing Jellyfin image providers and prefer artwork by language and resolution

versions.changelog:
- Fix no-language backdrops being filtered out when another image type has preferred-language artwork.
- Apply preferred and fallback language selection independently per image type.
- Fix plugin startup failure by removing the unsupported IHttpClientFactory activation dependency.
